one_liner: Bryce Harper got pitched around more than anyone here in 2025: just 42.7% of the pitches he saw were in the rulebook strike zone, the lowest zone rate in this group.
three_things: When he got something to hit, he punished it: 90th-percentile exit velocity 104.9 mph on 735 batted balls.
Estimated wOBA on contact .367, average exit velocity 84.0 mph.
Four-seam fastballs made up 27.9% of his 2,130-pitch diet.
context_note: Descriptive only, from a single 2025 Statcast pull (>=300 pitches-faced floor). Zone rate here is the share of pitches in the rulebook strike zone -- it does not measure his swing decisions or chase. Contact numbers are over the 735 batted balls only, not all 2,130 pitches, and estimated wOBA on contact is a batted-ball model that ignores walks and strikeouts. No swing/miss or launch-angle column in this pull. Not park- or opponent-adjusted; not a prediction. 'Lowest zone rate' is scoped to these twelve hitters.
